purpose: Instantiate the scalar finite-element gluing route on the candidate standard Iwasawa six-cell, producing explicit nodal boundary identifications while keeping bundle transitions, selected D_E, and matrices open.

constraint_rule.nodal_constraint: u[source_node]-u[target_node]=0 for every listed boundary identification
constraint_rule.quotient_basis: one scalar nodal degree of freedom per equivalence class
constraint_rule.prolongation: a closed-cell nodal vector is obtained by assigning each boundary-equivalent node the value of its quotient class representative

finite_basis_implication.scalar_FE_space: continuous or spectral-element functions on the closed six-cell with nodal values constrained by the deck equivalence relation
finite_basis_implication.nested_spaces: increase N and/or local polynomial order after this nodal gluing is imposed
finite_basis_implication.basis_skeleton_dimension_rule: after scalar quotient dof count s_N is chosen, form/fiber dimensions remain s_N*3*binomial(3,p)
finite_basis_implication.bundle_extension: for E-valued sections, replace scalar equality by s(source)=rho_E(gamma,source) s(target) before building Gram and stiffness matrices

verdict.next_step: Combine this scalar nodal gluing with rho_E bundle transition data, shape functions, quadrature, and the selected D_E action.
